summary: Retest of 3 fixes from iter_15 on tenant 'albero-della-vita' - ALL PASS. Backend: 19/19 tests green (7 new iter16 + 12 iter15 regression). Frontend: all 3 UI fixes confirmed. (1) Dashboard 'Attività di oggi' now shows full student names (GIORGIO ANTONIO VERRUSIO, FABRIZIA AMITA, ELIO CAROZZI, DANIEL DE ANGELIS, GIULIA DE GREGORIO…) with DD/MM/YYYY dates (12/10/2026) — zero truncated UUIDs detected on page. (2) /s/piano loads with 'Tutte' tab selected by default (bg-stone-900 text-white classes confirm dark/active state), 77 lesson-plan cards visible immediately, each with 'DD/MM/YYYY → DD/MM/YYYY' date range. No regressions.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix 1 (migration backfill of school_year_id on lesson_plans): worked. Still recommend persisting mysql_migrate.py change going forward so a re-run on a cleaned DB doesn't re-introduce the regression.
Fix 2 (menu field rename to valid_from/valid_to): worked. Confirm mysql_migrate.py source file was updated so idempotent re-runs produce correct schema.

Fix 3 (student-name map in Dashboard.jsx): good; however the component now triggers an extra /api/students fetch on every dashboard load — if 226+ grows to several thousand, consider a lightweight /api/students/map endpoint returning only {id, first_name, last_name} or memoizing with react-query.
